summary: Iter 25 — Smoke-tested the low-risk maintainability refactor across the 4 targeted pages: The Grid, Presence, My Leave & Tour, and SelfCheckIn (OT/EO reason prompts). No functional regressions detected; every acceptance criterion from the review request passed via Playwright on the preview URL. Lint clean across all 11 refactored/new files.
critical_code_review_comments: Review request wording says 'Athletes'/'Staff & Coaches' chips should have testids matching those labels, but the actual keys are backend-driven: `calendar-cat-filter-athlete` (singular) and `calendar-cat-filter-rest`. Same drift as iter24 flagged for ChurnRisk chips. Chips render + count correctly; only the testid string is different from the review-request wording — not a bug, just a heads-up so future automation authors don't hunt for `-athletes`/`-staff`.

MyLeaves route is `/my-leaves` (hyphenated) — the review request lists it as `/myleaves`. Direct nav to `/myleaves` silently falls back to the check-in home (no 404). Not a refactor bug, pre-existing; may want to add a redirect for the un-hyphenated form for QA convenience.

SelfCheckIn EO reason block was not present in the current in-office state at test time (admin was ~4.5h before work_start=09:30, so only the OT card fires). Reviewed the code path: SelfCheckIn.jsx L313-321 renders `<ReasonPrompt testId="early-out-reason" ...>` conditional on being checked-in and >15min before work_end. Logic looks correct; couldn't force both cards to appear in a single session on preview DB.
ReasonPrompt.jsx correctly wraps ReasonPicker and forwards `testId` — verified by `data-testid="ot-reason-block"` present on home page. Textarea inside is fully usable (typed + read-back successful).

GridFilterBar + GridRowTotals extraction is clean — CalendarGridTab.jsx is 486 LOC, imports the two subcomponents from `./calendar-grid/`. All existing testids (`calendar-name-search`, `calendar-rows-mode-toggle`, `cal-total-eo-*`, `calendar-cat-filter-*`) preserved. Row-mode toggle correctly doubles tr count (136 → 272). Name search 'Ajay' correctly filters to 2 rows.

MissingPhotoStrip.jsx extraction is a conditional-render — didn't fire on preview today (no members with missing on-campus photos). Reviewed the parent binding in Presence.jsx L369: strip is rendered inside the live-view branch with `<MissingPhotoStrip members={...} onStart={...}/>`. No JS errors on Presence page load. Non-blocking.

MyLeaves.jsx reduction from 892 → 649 LOC is confirmed; StatsDashboard + MyLeaveRow + utils extraction is clean. utils.js `round1`/`TYPE_LABELS`/`STATUS_COLORS` now shared with LeaveBalances.jsx and admin/Leaves.jsx (dedup win). Apply form opens; type toggles (Leave/Tour/Late Coming) all render; start/end/reason fields all editable.
